notes: A legis.md doc_id identifies one version (redaction) of an act, not the act: a newer version has a new doc_id. The engine finds the version in force on the task date and never trusts a stored doc_id as current.
A legislatie.just.ro doc_id identifies the act record; its consolidated text may lag behind amendments.
EU entries: the CELEX number was checked against the EU Publications Office (Cellar) on checked_on; the consolidated version in force is found on EUR-Lex on the task date.

status 'verified' means only that the identifier points to this act, checked on checked_on; it never means the text or its version in force was checked. 'reported' means the identifier comes from an earlier record or a secondary page and is re-checked on first run.
Law is never cached as truth: every conclusion that a rule is in force is re-checked against the official text on the task date.
